player_prompt.intro:
O Player {player_id}. O tlhoma Pino ya Memory.
Lefoko la gago ke go tsamaea pair tse ngata ya kadi mo bonging, go feta motho wa gago.
Ka mofuta wa gago, tlhophisa kadi pedi go a fetola ka go ngwala nomoro ya masheshe le tsela ya kadi ya ntlha le ya bobedi ka go bona '[0 1 1 0]', moo kadi ya ntlha e le mo mashesheng 0 le tsela 1, le kadi ya bobedi e le mo mashesheng 1 le tsela 0.
Uka kadi pedi e tsamaea, o rata nomoro le kadi e sala a bopeng. Uka e se tsamaee, kadi e fetolwa mo bophirima, e.g. '.'.
Pino e fedile fa pair tse tsamaee tsotlhe.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Mokgweleo o sa amogelesegang. Motshameki {player_id} ga a araba ka tsela e e siameng mo dikholomong tse di sekwere.
invalid_move.out_of_bounds: Motshameki {player_id} o tlhophile boemo jo bo kwa ntle ga melelwane.
invalid_move.same_card_twice: Go tsamaya go sa amogelesege. Motshameki {player_id} o tlhophile karata e le nngwe gabedi.
invalid_move.already_matched: Motshameki {player_id} o tlhophile karata e le nngwe kgotsa ka bobedi tse di setseng di bapisitswe.

game_message.cards_match: Dikarata tse tlhophiwang ke Player {player_id} kwa maemo a [{r1} {c1}] le [{r2} {c2}] di tshwana!
game_message.cards_no_match: Dikarata tse tlhophiwang ke Player {player_id} ga di tshwane. Dikarata kwa maemo a [{r1} {c1}] le [{r2} {c2}] di le {pos1} le {pos2} ka go latelana.

outcome.draw: Badiri ka bobedi ba ne ba tshwere palo e le nngwe ya dikarata.
outcome.turn_limit: Mofuta o fetilwe. Pino e fedile. Player 0 o ile a rata {score_0} dinomoro, Player 1 o ile a rata {score_1} dinomoro.
